channel.title: Juan Carlos — Research Log
channel.description: Research logs, derivations, and tutorials from personal machine learning projects, including an ongoing series rebuilding diffusion models from first principles.

item.title: In Search of PCA’s Lost Variance
item.description: A geometric derivation of why PCA reconstruction mean-squared error equals the sum of the discarded eigenvalues, through orthogonal projections and a 2D example.

item.title: Forward Process, Transformations, and Gregor Samsa
item.description: A derivation and geometric playground connecting the affine Gaussian transformation in a diffusion forward process to covariance and the Jacobian determinant.

item.title: Sampling Our Way Down, One Gaussian Step at a Time
item.description: A small-step Bayes derivation showing why the reverse conditional can be approximated by a Gaussian even when the previous-state marginal is not Gaussian.

item.title: KL Divergence Is Not a Distance
item.description: A daily-life example using car and train commute-time distributions to understand why KL divergence is asymmetric and how it can be used to compare distributions.

item.title: Two Ways to Learn the Same Score Field
item.description: A small experiment comparing two ways to train a toy neural network to learn the score of a noisy three-component Gaussian mixture.

item.title: Averaging Paths to the Peaks of Our Mountains
item.description: A derivation of how the noisy marginal score connects to the posterior conditional mean through an average over plausible clean samples.

item.title: Changing Variables Without Changing Probability
item.description: A short derivation of the density of a transformed random variable, with intuition for how the Jacobian compensates for stretched lengths and areas.

item.title: When the Score Does Not Point Straight to the Mean
item.description: An interactive look at how covariance reshapes the score of a multivariate Gaussian, and why the direction of higher density does not always point straight to the mean.

item.title: Denoising Is Not Inversion
item.description: A conditional-expectation note on why denoising under squared error is estimation, not exact inversion.

item.title: Score of a Gaussian
item.description: A derivation-driven note on why the score of a one-dimensional Gaussian points toward higher log-density, which means back toward the mean.

item.title: Expected Value of a Simple Forward Process
item.description: A diffusion note on what it really means for noisy images to stay centered around the original image on average.

item.title: Sequences of Bernoulli Outcomes with the Same Probability
item.description: A first-principles probability note on why conditioning on the total count makes all Bernoulli sequences with exactly k successes equally likely.
